title: 第五章 武库镇军三堂十八房第六章 牢狱庙神审讯庆丰
content_zh:
辞别王令史，离开马场，铁棠回到了运城县衙。
破案并不急于一时，尤其是这种复杂案件。
关键他的心思也不在破案上面，比起丢掉神捕的名头，他更不想丢掉自己的性命。
铁棠深知——有人要杀自己！
他刚穿越过来的时候，头颅受了重创，紧接着就是被人追杀。
起初还以为遇见了毛贼，但事后仔细回想，结合前身记忆，铁棠很快就发现了不妥之处。
当日前身为了调查一件悬案，深入运城之外的四方山，之后就遭遇了不测。
这是前身记忆中的一段空白。
在进入四方山后不久，到铁棠来到这方世界，这段时间的记忆....前身丢失了。
所以身为当事人的铁棠也不明白，那天究竟发生了什么。
追杀过后，铁棠得知了自己总捕头身份，曾经派遣大量人手前去搜寻那些毛贼，可惜一无所获。
当时看不出来，事后铁棠想起那个雨夜，知道那些不是寻常的毛贼凶徒，而是训练有素的人手。
有人要杀自己，或者说是杀掉前身！
很显然对方的目的已经达到了，可惜对方不自知。
这才是铁棠最苦恼的地方。
这一个月来他躲在县衙校场，除了提高自身实力，就是想找出到底是谁要杀自己。
“到底是谁要杀我？前身好像也没知道什么。”
铁棠早就把前身的记忆粗略看过一遍，如同看了一部励志电影。
前身孤儿出身，标准主角模板。
依靠自强不息、勤奋努力，加上大商皇朝良好的吏治、开明的政策，有惊无险成长了起来。

随后更是从捕役一路做到了总捕头位置，期间为了破案自是得罪了不少人。
好在前身也不是耿直的愣头青，做事留有余地。得罪人并没有得罪死，至少还没有到要杀掉他的地步。
这些经历并不能看出谁要对他不利，但铁棠还是锁定了重点。
那就是前身最后调查的那件悬案之上。
可仅从前身的记忆当中，并没有看出什么不妥。
那件悬案是真正的悬案，已经悬了将近十年，甚至都快过了诉讼期限。
“想不通啊.....会是谁？”
“庆丰？”
“还是段景瑞？”
这两位是铁棠的首要怀疑目标，他们就是运城捕快之中，仅此于自己的两大县捕。
距离总捕头只有一步之遥，可谓是利益相关！
“庆丰已经刑拘，不如趁此良机前去试探一下。”铁棠起身，就要去往县衙监狱。
却在此时，有一身着黑袍，腰悬佩刀的男子快速走了进来。
“总捕头，属下有要事禀报。”
他的服饰与青衣捕役、蓝衣捕快都不相同，但铁棠看到他却很高兴。
“许游，你来得正好。”
content_en:
After bidding farewell to Wang Lingshi and leaving the racecourse, Tie Tang returned to Yuncheng County Yamen.
There is no rush to solve a case, especially a complex case like this.
The key is that his mind is not on solving the case. He doesn't want to lose his own life more than losing his reputation as a detective.
Tie Tang knew very well that someone wanted to kill him!
When he first crossed over, he suffered a serious head injury, and then he was hunted down.
At first he thought he had met a thief, but after careful reflection and combined with the memory of his predecessor, Tie Tang quickly discovered something was wrong.
That day, my predecessor went deep into Sifang Mountain outside Yuncheng to investigate an unsolved case, and then encountered an unexpected incident.
This is a gap in the memory of the predecessor.
Shortly after entering Sifang Mountain, Tietang came to this world, and the memory of this period...the predecessor was lost.
Therefore, Tie Tang, who was involved in the incident, did not understand what happened that day.
After the chase, Tie Tang learned of his identity as the chief catcher and sent a large number of manpower to search for the thieves, but unfortunately found nothing.
He couldn't tell it at the time, but later Tie Tang thought about that rainy night and realized that those were not ordinary thieves, but well-trained personnel.
Someone wants to kill him, or his predecessor!
It's obvious that the other party's goal has been achieved, but it's a pity that the other party doesn't know it.
This is what troubles Tie Tang the most.
In the past month, he had been hiding in the county government school. In addition to improving his strength, he also wanted to find out who wanted to kill him.
"Who wants to kill me? My predecessor doesn't seem to know anything."
Tie Tang had already roughly reviewed the memories of his predecessor, as if watching an inspirational movie.
The predecessor was an orphan, a standard protagonist template.
Relying on self-improvement, hard work, and the good governance and enlightened policies of the Great Shang Dynasty, it grew up without any danger.
Later, he worked his way up from the catcher to the chief catcher position. During this period, he offended many people in order to solve the case.
Fortunately, his predecessor was not an upright young man, so he had room to do things. Offending someone does not offend death, at least not to the point of killing him.
These experiences did not reveal who was going to harm him, but Tie Tang still focused on the key points.
That was on top of the last unsolved case investigated by the predecessor.
But just from the memory of the predecessor, nothing wrong could be seen.
That cold case was a real cold case. It had been pending for nearly ten years, and it was almost past the deadline for litigation.
"I can't figure it out...who could it be?"
"Qingfeng?"
"Or Duan Jingrui?"
These two are Tie Tang's primary targets of suspicion. They are among the Yuncheng police officers, second only to his own two county police officers.
We are only one step away from the total capture, which can be said to be a matter of interest!
"Qingfeng has been detained, why not take this opportunity to test it out." Tie Tang stood up and was about to go to the county jail.
But at this moment, a man in black robes with a sword hanging from his waist walked in quickly.
"The chief arrester, my subordinates have something important to report."
His clothes were different from those of the detectives in green and blue, but Tie Tang was very happy to see him.
"Xu You, you came just in time."
